data.task_title: Create Artemis self-demo with Chart.js visualization

features.title: Implement Chart.js Visualizations
features.description: Use Chart.js to create visualizations for pipeline metrics, cost tracking, and success rates.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline metrics are visualized using Chart.js
Cost tracking is displayed with appropriate charts
Success rates are shown with interactive elements

features.title: Display Real-Time Metrics Dashboard
features.description: Create a real-time dashboard with Chart.js graphs for LLM cost, stage completion rates, and success trends.
acceptance_criteria: LLM cost over time is shown with a line chart
Stage completion rates are displayed with a bar chart
Success rate trends are visualized with an area chart

features.title: Showcase Artemis Features
features.description: Highlight key features of Artemis such as cost tracking, sandboxing, and learning using charts.
acceptance_criteria: Features are clearly explained with accompanying charts
Charts accurately represent feature metrics
Information is easy to understand and engaging

features.title: Create Standalone HTML Presentation
features.description: Develop a single HTML file with embedded CSS, JavaScript, and Chart.js for showcasing Artemis capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: HTML file includes embedded CSS and JavaScript
Chart.js library is integrated for data visualization
File is self-contained with no external dependencies

features.title: Present Real Metrics from Recent Runs
features.description: Include actual data from recent Artemis runs to demonstrate system performance.
acceptance_criteria: Recent run data is accurately represented
Charts reflect real-world performance metrics
Data is current and relevant to the audience

features.title: Illustrate Code Quality Metrics
features.description: Use a radar chart to demonstrate TDD compliance and adherence to SOLID principles.
acceptance_criteria: Radar chart displays TDD compliance metrics
SOLID principles are represented in the chart
Chart is clear and informative

features.title: Auto-Advance Slides with Navigation Controls
features.description: Enable slides to auto-advance with user navigation controls for manual progression.
acceptance_criteria: Slides auto-advance after a set duration
Navigation controls allow manual slide progression
Controls are intuitive and responsive

features.title: Integrate Supervisor Across Stages
features.description: Visualize supervisor integration across different stages using a pie chart.
acceptance_criteria: Pie chart accurately represents supervisor integration
Chart is interactive and easy to interpret
Integration data is up-to-date and relevant

features.title: Design Professional Presentation
features.description: Incorporate a professional gradient background and smooth transitions in the presentation.
acceptance_criteria: Gradient background is applied consistently
Transitions between slides are smooth and professional
Overall design is visually appealing
